summary: The P1 selection-race correction, P2 dependency/boundary foundation and P3 UI implementation are coherent. Two bounded acceptance gaps remain: confirmed session deletion does not purge its retained draft, and the evidence wrapper does not record the required exact build/source/fixture identity. Neither requires replanning or a framework change.

open_findings.title: Purge the confirmed-deleted session retained draft
open_findings.observed: Confirmed removal reconciles selection but emits no event/callback to Workbench drafts ref. Deleted session text remains retained until window close.
open_findings.correction: Notify the existing draft owner of exact confirmed workspace/session removal; delete only that key regardless of navigation generation. Preserve other drafts and cancellation/unknown/failure. Add focused regression.
open_findings.classification: Confirmed source-level acceptance omission; not reproduced in a new live run.

open_findings.title: Record exact identities in exported capture manifests
open_findings.observed: Exported capture manifests lack exact build/source/fixture fingerprints. Current reviewer used separately supplied binding/provenance; captures were not claimed stale.
open_findings.correction: Add bounded build/script/fixture/source fingerprints, associate build-time source identity where available and test emitted fields. Do not relabel historical captures with unverified current identity.

scope: Implemented P1/P2/P3 only; plan revision6/specv4; future P4-P7 not approved.

bundle_judgment.basis: Required Dialog/DropdownMenu behavior and complete scoped styling justify disclosed growth; no immediate alternate library or split is justified. P6 performance remains required.

limitations: Read-only source/capture review; no tests rerun.
Supplemental p3-r7/workbench report inspected but not represented as part of the pre-existing verification digest.

provenance.independence: Reviewer did not implement or repair the reviewed changes.
